scenario: Two domains appear in strings; traffic_log shows a connection only to the benign one.

supported_findings: Strings reference two domains: news-cdn.example.com (labeled with articles_fetch, consistent with the app's stated function) and suspicious-relay.example.com (labeled config_backup_url).
The traffic_log shows exactly one connection, to news-cdn.example.com only -- there is no traffic_log entry for suspicious-relay.example.com in this case.
The presence of suspicious-relay.example.com in strings without any corroborating connection means its purpose and whether it was ever contacted cannot be determined from this case's evidence alone.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that the app connected to suspicious-relay.example.com -- no traffic_log entry supports this.
Any claim that news-cdn.example.com is the suspicious domain -- the evidence points the other way: it is the one with confirmed, function-consistent traffic.
Any claim resolving what suspicious-relay.example.com is used for -- this case's evidence does not establish that.
known_contradictions: strings reference both news-cdn.example.com and suspicious-relay.example.com, but traffic_log shows a connection only to news-cdn.example.com.
